registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible: the registered office may be the physical street address of a licensed Cyprus Corporate Services Provider (CSP) acting as virtual office, which satisfies Section 121 of Companies Law Cap. 113 for service of process; a P.O. Box is prohibited. However, for this Real-Time Video Matching and Cross-Border Social Telephony entity earning Apple_IAP and Paymentwall revenues, the company must demonstrate genuine management and control in Cyprus - majority of directors resident in Cyprus, board meetings held and minuted in Cyprus, full Cypriot statutory records, and a Cyprus-based bank or EMI account - to establish tax residence and to resist BEPS/CFC challenges from ultimate shareholder jurisdictions; a purely artificial virtual arrangement is rebuttable under the Cyprus management-and-control test.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 12-18% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by DRCOROIP or MOKAS where the registered office is a CSP virtual office; 25-35% documentary substance-verification probability triggered by merchant onboarding on Apple IAP and Paymentwall, or by submission of a Cyprus corporation tax return with zero substance indicators.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Taxation, Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus — Tax for All (Ariadne) digital portal: https://taxforAll.mof.gov.cy
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Cyprus private limited company (HE77) obtains its statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) at incorporation via the Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property; the same TIN is used for income tax and VAT. VAT registration is a separate procedure completed through Form TD1025 (Application for VAT Registration / Voluntary or Compulsory); non-resident companies making taxable supplies in Cyprus (other than distance sales below threshold) must register for VAT irrespective of local turnover and should appoint a local VAT representative where the EU VAT Refund Directive 2008/9/EC threshold applies. Digital platform operators supplying B2C services from outside Cyprus can register under the Cyprus OSS portal (VAT MOSS) to obviate local mandatory registration when EU-wide turnover of distance sales / TBE services exceeds EUR 10,000. The Tax Department issues a separate VAT registration number in the form CY12345678X upon lodgement of supporting incorporation certificate, registered office certificate, passports of directors, and proof of place of business.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — Cyprus tax-resident companies (incorporated in Cyprus are deemed resident) are subject to corporate income tax at 12.5% on worldwide income, with territorial in-rem exemption on non-Cyprus permanent establishment income where the non-resident target is taxed at a nominal rate of at least 11.5%; the entity does not qualify for pass-through treatment under Cyprus general tax law and is not a deemed tax-transparent entity for Cyprus purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Cyprus check-the-box analogue: (i) group loss relief election under Art. 19-21 of the Income Tax Law 118(I)/2002 with 87.5% common ownership; (ii) IP Box regime election (deduction equal to 80% of qualifying intangible-derived profit under Art. 9F); (iii) Notional Interest Deduction (NID) election on new equity (Art. 9E); (iv) tonnage tax opt-in for qualifying shipping (Merchant Shipping Law); (v) tax transparency election for partnerships only, not for limited companies; (vi) dividend and capital gains anti-hybrid adjustments governed by EU ATAD 2 (DAC6 MDR reporting) affecting hybrid mismatch arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) administered under the Value Added Tax Law of 2000 (Law 167(I)/2000), aligned with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 15,600 annual turnover for Cyprus-established taxable persons; nil threshold for non-established suppliers of taxable services or goods (other than distance sales) in Cyprus; EUR 35,000 for intra-Community distance sales of goods to Cyprus consumers; EUR 10,000 EU-wide annual turnover threshold (in EUR) for cross-border B2C telecommunications, broadcasting and electronic services under the OSS — the CY_LTD video-match in-app subscription app is treated as an electronically supplied service and is compulsorily registrable in Cyprus from first euro if the business is Cyprus-established.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Cyprus implements EU Directive 2014/55/EU e-invoicing standard (European Norm EN-16931; Peppol BIS) for public procurement; mandatory B2B e-invoicing clearance is not yet fully enforced as of 2025 but the Tax Department mandates: (i) real-time or near-real-time issuance of fiscal receipts through Cyprus-certified Electronic Fiscal Devices (EFD) for domestic services and retail activities; (ii) submission of VAT data through the Ariadne/taxforAll portal, with planned extension to full PEPPOL-based continuous transaction controls (CTC) clearance — API connections are required for certified EFD interop, and QR-code digital stamping is enforced on fiscal receipts for physical retail; cloud SaaS/in-app digital supplies have no separate pencil-and-paper exemption, requiring issuance of electronic VAT invoices within 30 days and e-archiving of XML files for 6 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (i) export of goods physically leaving the EU (Art. 146 VAT Directive; Cyprus VAT Law Art. 14) with proof of dispatch within 90 days and receipt of export declaration; (ii) intra-Community supplies of goods to another EU taxable person holding a valid EU VAT ID within the IVS (VIES) — CY_LTD's cross-border video matching app qualifies for favourable treatment on B2B digital services through the reverse-charge mechanism; (iii) international transport services or services directly related to goods for export (including app-store advertising links to export transactions are excluded — pure data/ad services do not qualify). As the video-chat app sells B2C digital subscriptions via Apple IAP and Paymentwall, the underlying supplies are not export zero-rated but are 'electronically supplied services'; place of supply for B2C is the customer's country of establishment/residence, and the OSS shall be used to charge local VAT at destination; zero-rating is claimable only for intra-group technical hosting services where the recipient is a foreign business customer (reverse charge) with documentary evidence of the recipient's VAT ID and conclusion of contract.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Cyprus (Kentriki Trapeza tis Kyprou / Central Bank of Cyprus, CBC), acting as the national prudential supervisor and eurosystem National Central Bank; residual capital-control administration was historically shared with the Cypriot Ministry of Finance under the Suspension of Payments and Capital Controls Law of 2013 (L.87(I)/2013), but that emergency framework expired in full in 2015 and no successor exchange-control authority exists today.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Republic of Cyprus maintains no operative exchange-control or capital-authorisation regime. The euro is fully convertible on both the capital account and the current account, as guaranteed by Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (free movement of capital). Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are unencumbered: Cyprus imposes zero withholding tax on dividends, interest, and royalties, and there is no need for CBC pre-approval for equity injections, shareholder loans, dividend declarations, or profit repatriation. The only practical hurdle is the implementing banks balance-of-payments (BoP) statistical reporting obligation; any transfer exceeding EUR 12,500 must be tagged with the correct EU BPM6 purpose code on the wire or e-banking remittance instruction, and the bank will request a standard source-of-funds declaration for exceptional amounts. There is no distinction between resident and non-resident accounts for convertibility purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion rules apply to a Cyprus resident company. The euro is the domestic currency; the entity receives EUR-denominated settlement flows from Apple IAP and Paymentwall merchant-of-record structures, and there is no statutory timeline for repatriation, no percentage-based conversion ratio, and no requirement to convert foreign-currency receipts through an authorised dealer within a fixed period. The residual compliance duty is the CBC statistical directive requiring banks to report all cross-border and high-value transactions (threshold EUR 12,500) with a valid BPM6 purpose code, which the treasury must pre-map against each payment stream.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High viability as a supplementary fast-settlement rail, but Low viability as the sole primary treasury account. CBC-licensed e-money institutions, such as locally licensed EMIs offering virtual IBANs, are legally viable for instant EUR disbursements, SEPA CT, and sub-ledger automation, and passported EU/EEA EMIs (e.g., UK- or EU-headquartered digital payment platforms) may operate in Cyprus through the payment-service passporting regime under the Cyprus Electronic Money Law (L.81(I)/2018). However, no EMI can hold capital-escrow evidence, issue documentary credits, grant bank comfort, or be used alone to substantiate the Cyprus substance required by the tax examiner. Non-EEA offshore digital EMIs that do not hold a passporting notice in Cyprus should not be used as the principal deposit corridor; they are acceptable only as inbound merchant-of-record collection rails (e.g., Paymentwall settling globally), while the treasury waterfall must always end at a Tier-1 Cypriot bank account to avoid an AML/sanctions integrity problem with the CBC and correspondent banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical onboarding is the prevailing market-practice mandate at Tier-1 Cypriot banks: at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner, or a duly authorised senior manager holding a notarised power of attorney, must attend an in-person KYC/CDD interview at the bank's principal branch in Nicosia or Limassol. Fully remote opening is generally unavailable for a Medium-Risk-Enhanced social-telephony client. Video/remote identification may be used only as a supplementary step after the physical session, and only when the entity has been introduced by a regulated Cyprus corporate service provider (advocate, accountant, or CySEC-authorised nominee/administration firm). A pragmatic bank-specific mitigant accepted by Hellenic Bank and Bank of Cyprus is an initial video-conference verification of certified-true document copies for foreign-resident directors, followed by a physical visit within 90 days; however, this concession is discretionary and cannot be relied upon in the treasury plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag — 'High-risk UGC consumer-payment loop': random video-match applications are commonly associated with adult-content exposure, financial sextortion, romance scams, and trafficking proceeds flowing through in-app micropayments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle required at onboarding: (1) full product and payment-flow deck proving the app mediates only live video chat and does not host adult content; (2) executed merchant agreements with Apple (IAP) and Paymentwall showing the consumer pays to an App Store or merchant-of-record intermediary, not directly to CY_LTD; (3) historical chargeback, refund, and dispute statistics per quarter; (4) content-moderation and age-verification SOPs, including the third-party moderation vendor contract; (5) evidence that all settlement flows are captured in a single EUR corporate account with no crypto-asset conversion or micro-splitting; (6) an independent AML/CDD appraisal from a licensed Cyprus auditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 'Sanctions and geoblocking integrity' — failure to demonstrate exclusion of Russian, Belarusian, Iranian, North Korean, and other sanctioned-jurisdiction users, or undisclosed exposure to high-risk traffic corridors, will trigger automatic red-listing by the CBC, World-Check, and SWIFT bystander-bank filters.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) IP-geolocation and SIM-box detection policy that automatically blocks EEA/US OFAC and EU-restrictive-measure territories; (2) periodic sanctions-screening log and an export of the app's geo-blocklist from the CDN; (3) a declaration that no payments are made from or to sanctioned persons, accompanied by the company register extract, UBO register filing under section 61A of the Cyprus Companies Law, and tax-residence certificates; (4) external penetration-test report on the payment-gateway integration; (5) a written undertaking to notify the bank within 48 hours of any change in market coverage or payment-rail composition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 'Beneficial-ownership obfuscation' — a Cyprus Ltd with nominee-shareholder arrangements, fast corporate restructuring, or a shareholder who cannot demonstrate the source of wealth for the equity injection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) shareholding and option-warrant genesis history since incorporation, certified by the registered secretary; (2) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds file for the Cypriot shareholder (bank statements, sale-purchase agreements, exit-event proceeds); (3) Cyprus Registrar of Companies extract and beneficial-owner declaration; (4) global organisational chart with all intermediate holding companies located in EU/OECD jurisdictions; (5) audited financial statements or management accounts for the last two years and a board resolution approving the bank relationship.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: book the inbound contribution through SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the shareholder's own bank account, using the beneficiary IBAN of CY_LTD at the chosen Tier-1 bank and the remittance reference 'Direct Investment — Equity Capital (BPM6 F.1)'. Cyprus banks require the remitter to state the EU BPM6 purpose code even on intra-EU transfers; for an equity injection the accepted tag is the CBC BoP category 'FDI — Equity'. The bank will additionally request: (i) a notarised copy of the directors' resolution approving the share issue or capital increase; (ii) the share subscription agreement and updated register of members; (iii) source-of-funds detail for amounts above EUR 50,000; (iv) CRS/CIS declarations where the remitter is a tax-transparent entity; and (v) confirmation in the CBC anti-illicit-financing circular format that the transfer is not routed through a third-country or non-bank exchanger and is not sanction-tainted. Shareholder loans must be separately tagged as 'Shareholder Loan (BPM6 F.5)' and supported by a signed facility note with an arm's-length interest rate and repayment schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for recurrent operating disbursements (data-centre hosts, cloud capacity, moderation services, software subscriptions) is the single customer credit transfer via SWIFT MT103, or the SEPA-CT rail for EU beneficiaries, each carrying the matching ECB BPM6 service category 'Telecommunications, computer and information services'. For high-value hardware acquisitions, the rail escalates to a commercial letter of credit (SWIFT MT700/MT710) coupled with airway bills, pro-forma invoices, and certificates of origin where the counterparty sits in a higher-risk jurisdiction. Intra-group treasury cash-pooling should use SWIFT CAMT (camt.053/camt.054) statement interfaces and documented inter-company loans evidenced by signed loan agreements. All outgoing wires above EUR 12,500 must be pre-tagged with the CBC-mandated transaction category or they will be suspended pending a narrative declaration; the treasury policy must therefore pre-map purpose codes for content moderation, software services, director reimbursements, tax prepayments, and dividends.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD foreign-exchange forwards (plain vanilla, up to 12-month tenor) executed under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a Tier-1 counterparty — permitted without CBC pre-authorisation as a hedge of the entity's USD-denominated Apple IAP revenue.
EUR/USD FX swaps (swap-points transactions) for short-term liquidity conversion between EUR and USD treasury balances, settled on the banking-day or T+2 corridor.

Cross-currency swaps (XCCY) and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for long-dated USD liability mirroring (e.g., financing or shareholder debt), subject to clearing capacity and uncleared-margin-rules (UMR) eligibility screening.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) — permitted only as an exception for non-convertible emerging-market settlement currencies (e.g., USD/CNH where a deliverable forward is impossible), and subject to bank counterparty approval, CBC UMR screening, and an explicit board-approved hedging policy; NDFs are not used for EUR/USD because the pair is fully convertible and deliverable in the Cypriot market.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Cyprus limited companies must appoint a certified auditor. Audit exemption applies to 'small companies' meeting at least two of the following in the financial year: balance sheet total <= EUR 350,000; net turnover <= EUR 700,000; average employees <= 10. Dormant companies are wholly exempt. Public-interest entities and banking/insurance companies are never exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements prepared under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the EU or Cyprus GAAP (Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU). Audited/unaudited statutory accounts constitute the foundation for corporate income tax computation and filing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must annually confirm its ultimate beneficial owners with the Registrar of Companies each calendar year (by 30 June). Any transfer of shares or change in ownership requires a declaration update within 14 days. Confirmation is submitted via the official UBO registry portal and is recorded against the company's registration file.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 324 – USD 1,620 (EUR 300 – EUR 1,500 depending on scope)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,160 – USD 6,480 (EUR 2,000 – EUR 6,000 for a small-to-mid-sized technology company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday is available. The effective tax rate is reduced by: (i) the IP Box regime, which exempts 80% of qualifying profits from qualifying intangible property under the modified nexus approach, delivering an effective 2.5% rate; (ii) the Notional Interest Deduction (NID), which permits a deduction equal to a calendar-year reference rate (10-year Cyprus government bond yield plus 3%) on new qualifying equity introduced after 1 January 2015; and (iii) the full participation exemption on dividend income and certain capital gains. The aggregate effect may lower the effective rate materially but each incentive requires contemporaneous substance and documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form TD4 (Company Income Tax Return) filed through the Cyprus Tax Department e-Filing Portal (Taxisnet/Ariadeni online subsystem).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline: within 15 months after the end of the calendar tax year (for a 31 December year end, by 31 March of the second following year). Provisional tax: 75% of estimated annual tax is due by 31 December of the current year; the remaining balance is due by 31 July of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company number (HE#####), Tax Identification Code, registered office address, principal activity (ISIC 6311 – data processing and hosting; real-time video application), fiscal year end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Cyprus entity files in its own name; overseas shareholders and directors need not be disclosed in the return beyond the registry filings. No ITIN/GN is required for non-resident shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B / Statement of Comprehensive Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Turnover from Apple IAP and Paymentwall receipts, cost of sales, administrative expenses, operating profit, finance income/costs, exceptional items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All amounts must be converted to EUR using the Central Bank of Cyprus exchange rate; income arising in Cyprus is taxable to the Cyprus company. No foreign tax credit is available to the shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additions and deductions per the Income Tax Law, including non-deductible entertainment, fines, transfer pricing adjustments, notional interest deduction, IP box deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident related-party transactions above the EUR 250,000 threshold must be referenced and supported by an arm's length file; however, the return does not require the TP documentation to be uploaded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unexpired tax losses brought forward (maximum carry-forward five years) to be set off against taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are ring-fenced within the Cyprus tax-resident entity; no proportional carry-over to foreign shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E / Tax Computation and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income at 12.5%, final corporate income tax, refundable credits, provisional payments already made, balance due or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No withholding tax is applied to distributions to non-resident shareholders; the box records only the Cyprus corporate tax liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic penalty of EUR 100 plus EUR 50 per day of delay, subject to a maximum of EUR 4,500. Late payment: statutory interest of 1% per month (12% per annum) on the underpaid balance. Willful failure to file or knowingly submitting false information may be prosecuted in court, exposing the company to a fine of up to EUR 17,086 and, on conviction, to imprisonment of the responsible officer for up to five years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Cyprus does not impose domestic withholding tax on dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because domestic law imposes a 0% dividend withholding rate, no administrative relief is required for a dividend to be distributed free of Cypriot withholding tax. When a treaty or EU Directive is nevertheless invoked (e.g., for an EU parent's certificate request), the protocol is: (i) shareholder obtains a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) for the tax year; (ii) the Cyprus paying agent completes, where requested, the IRS/UK/CY treaty relief declaration (no Cyprus-specific form exists for 0% dividends); (iii) the TRC is retained in the company's tax file and produced within 30 days if the Tax Department requests verification; and (iv) if a legacy DTA imposes a positive rate, the non-resident may file an application for pre-clearance with the District Tax Office and an amended Form TD4 within the relevant time limits. In practice, the 0% domestic exemption prevails and no DTA application is needed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic law: 0% withholding on royalties and 0% withholding on interest paid to non-residents. Most Cyprus DTAs also provide 0% royalty withholding; for interest, older treaties may allow source taxation of up to 10%, but internal law only recognizes a nil rate. The non-resident recipient's interest/royalty income is taxable solely in its country of residence, and a Cyprus payer has no statutory obligation to withhold.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File must be prepared when the aggregate value of controlled transactions with a related party exceeds EUR 250,000 annually. Master File must be prepared when the aggregate value of controlled transactions exceeds EUR 5,000,000 annually. CbC reporting applies to MNE groups whose consolidated revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Cyprus has no codified Economic Substance Regulations (ESR); however, economic substance is a core legal requirement derived from the statutory 'central management and control' test for tax residence, the OECD TP Guidelines, and the EU ATAD/ATAD2 rules. For an ISIC 6311 video-match app operator, substance requires: (i) board meetings of the Cyprus directors held in Cyprus at regular frequencies; (ii) local employment with functional responsibility for commercial contracts, moderation, cybersecurity, and analytics; (iii) office premises and actual day-to-day operations; and (iv) qualified personnel dedicated to managing IP rights if the IP Box regime is claimed. The Cyprus Tax Department may deny tax residence or reclassify income when a shell profile is detected; apps that generate high revenue with minimal local activity are especially sensitive to source/situs challenges from Apple IAP and Paymentwall flows.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – Fraudulent Under-reporting of Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or under-recognition of Apple IAP and Paymentwall receipts in the financial statements; recording personal expenses as corporate costs; issuing fictitious invoices for content moderation in low-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional assessment for the shortfall, statutory interest at 1% per month, and an administrative penalty of up to 100% of the deficient tax. On criminal conviction, fines of up to EUR 17,086 and imprisonment for up to five years; conviction may also lead to publication of the taxpayer's name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause or permit the false filings are personally liable under the Companies Law, Cap. 113 for fraudulent trading (civil restitution to the tax authority and creditors); courts may issue travel bans and asset-freeze orders. For egregious evasion involving cross-border receipts, an extradition route exists under Cyprus extradition treaties, and imprisonment is available as a term of sentencing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Cyprus company holds only the IP license or app brand and records intercompany service fees while all decision-makers, employees, and bank accounts are located outside Cyprus; the company is presented to banks as engaging in video-app business but performs no operational function.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Tax Commissioner may invoke the central management and control test to deny Cypriot tax residence on a retrospective basis, thereby exposing income to taxation in the actual place of management and to transfer pricing penalties. Under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD), the company may be disregarded or its payments recharacterized. The Registrar of Companies may strike the company off the register for non-filing or dissolution if the registered address fails to establish any business activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The veil of incorporation is pierced where directors allow the company to be used as a mere conduit for tax avoidance: directors face joint and several restitution of the tax deficiency, disqualification orders, asset freezes, and travel restrictions. A travel ban may be imposed under the Cyprus Exchange Control and Court Practice where there is risk of dissipation of assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Counter-Financing of Terrorism – Inadequate KYC and Reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a random video-match app with payment rails (Apple IAP and Paymentwall) but failing to apply risk-based customer due diligence (CDD), failing to monitor high-value in-app tips, failing to identify anomalies for minors or sanctioned users, and omitting to file suspicious transaction reports (STRs) with the Cyprus Financial Intelligence Unit (MOKAS).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under the AML Law (Law 188(I)/2007, as amended) of up to EUR 200,000 for each violation; for the legal person and responsible individuals, criminal conviction can impose fines of up to two times the value of the laundered assets plus imprisonment for up to five years. Failure to obtain a service-provider licence (where the business crosses into financial activities) triggers further enforcement under the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission framework; in this scope no statutory license is required, but the enhanced medium-risk AML profile demands written procedures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed anti-money laundering compliance officer (where required) are personally liable for non-submission of STRs if they had knowledge or suspicion of money laundering. Financial sanctions and travel bans can be imposed by the Cyprus Courts under the Prevention and Suppression of Money-Laundering Activities Law; a director's personal bank accounts and assets are subject to freezing orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-compliance and Cross-border Margin Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Cyprus app-operator entity realizes persistent losses or near-zero margins while associated software-services companies in a low-tax jurisdiction achieve significant profits from the same users; no Local File/Master File is prepared; no benchmark or TP policy exists for the Paymentwall payment-processing fee and Apple IAP commission.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner may adjust the taxable profit applying the arm's length principle under the Income Tax Law and the Transfer Pricing Rules of 2022, impose penalties on the additional assessment at up to 100% of the additional tax, and charge monthly default interest. Failure to produce TP documentation after a written demand triggers a fixed administrative fine of EUR 2,500 and a further daily fine of EUR 100, subject to a total of EUR 20,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who direct the intercompany margin policy are not automatically liable for the TP adjustment, but if they personally prepared or approved adjusted documentation with false facts, they are exposed to civil liability for fraudulent misrepresentation and criminal penalties for tax evasion. Where the lack of documentation results in a liquidation scenario, directors may be personally responsible for unpaid taxes under the fraudulent preference rule and for acts of reckless trading.
